Use Coupon: SAVE70% New Price after Discount: $17.96/year'; body text: '70% Discount for Life', 'Annual Billing only', 'Limited time, flash deal ... until August 31st'; datacenter 'Amsterdam, Netherlands'

the vendor homepage was read and carries no VPS price table: the extracted page is a features and services page whose VPS section is prose ('Experience high-performance VPS hosting with fast NVMe storage and dedicated resources') with a cart link and no figures
the path answers HTTP 200 and extracts to 133 bytes: the title, then the headings 'features', 'products' and 'testimonials' with no body text under any of them
a second path on the same host extracts to 117 bytes of the same shape, so the plan tables are script-rendered on both
the homepage carries web-hosting prices only ('yearlyPrice: $35.88', 'monthlyPrice: $2.99', 'yearlyPrice: $11.40', 'monthlyPrice: $2.45') and links no storage product

record.notes: json and storage/feral-hosting-radon match on the string for unrelated reasons. The offer window closed eleven days after the post was published, so the price is not orderable today as written, and the record is kept with that stated rather than dropped: a lifetime discount that recurs is exactly the sort of offer that comes back. verification criteria: whether SAVE70% reapplies at the next flash sale, and the pre-coupon list price, which no page read prints.
